title: 0083 프로젝트 단계 사진 — 서버만 쓰고 읽는다(구성원 · 익명 deny) · 그 업체 그 프로젝트의 자리에만 · 올린 내용은 못 바꾸고 지운 줄은 못 되살린다 · 버킷 비공개 5MB
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'agent', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'expert', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, {{y_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.customers (id, company_id, name) VALUES ({{customer_x}}, {{company_x}}, 'probe'), ({{customer_y}}, {{company_y}}, 'probe')
INSERT INTO public.projects (id, company_id, customer_id, title) VALUES ({{project_x}}, {{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, 'probe X'), ({{project_y}}, {{company_y}}, {{customer_y}}, 'probe Y')

INSERT INTO public.project_files (id, company_id, project_id, stage, path, note, created_by) VALUES ({{file_live}}, {{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'measure', ({{company_x}}::text || '/' || {{project_x}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.jpg'), 'probe', {{x_owner_user}})

INSERT INTO public.project_files (id, company_id, project_id, stage, path, created_by) VALUES ({{file_gone}}, {{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'install', ({{company_x}}::text || '/' || {{project_x}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.png'), {{x_owner_user}})
UPDATE public.project_files SET deleted_at = now(), deleted_by = {{x_owner_user}} WHERE id = {{file_gone}}

checks.name: 사진 읽기 — 서버만 (구성원 · 익명 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.project_files where project_id = {{project_x}}

checks.name: 지운 사진 — 줄은 남고 지운 때 · 사람이 찍혔다 (준비 단계에서 지웠다)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.project_files where id = {{file_gone}} and deleted_at is not null and deleted_by = {{x_owner_user}}

checks.name: 올리기 — 서버가 한 줄 넣는다 (단계 · 자리 · 메모)
checks.sql: insert into public.project_files (company_id, project_id, stage, path, note, created_by) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'consult', ({{company_x}}::text || '/' || {{project_x}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.jpg'), 'probe', {{x_owner_user}})

checks.name: 단계 이름은 여덟 가지뿐
checks.sql: insert into public.project_files (company_id, project_id, stage, path) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'party', ({{company_x}}::text || '/' || {{project_x}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.jpg'))

checks.name: 자리는 그 업체 · 그 프로젝트 것만 (남의 프로젝트 자리로는 거절)
checks.sql: insert into public.project_files (company_id, project_id, stage, path) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'measure', ({{company_y}}::text || '/' || {{project_y}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.jpg'))

checks.name: 파일은 jpg · png 만
checks.sql: insert into public.project_files (company_id, project_id, stage, path) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'measure', ({{company_x}}::text || '/' || {{project_x}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.gif'))

checks.name: 메모는 200자까지
checks.sql: insert into public.project_files (company_id, project_id, stage, path, note) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'measure', ({{company_x}}::text || '/' || {{project_x}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.jpg'), repeat('가', 201))

checks.name: 같은 자리를 두 번 넣지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.project_files (company_id, project_id, stage, path) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'measure', (select path from public.project_files where id = {{file_live}}))

checks.name: 같은 업체 프로젝트에만 (남의 업체 id 로는 거절 — 자리 글은 맞춰도)
checks.sql: insert into public.project_files (company_id, project_id, stage, path) values ({{company_y}}, {{project_x}}, 'measure', ({{company_y}}::text || '/' || {{project_x}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.jpg'))

checks.name: 새 사진은 지운 것으로 넣지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.project_files (company_id, project_id, stage, path, deleted_at) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'measure', ({{company_x}}::text || '/' || {{project_x}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.jpg'), now())

checks.name: 구성원은 사진 줄을 직접 넣지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.project_files (company_id, project_id, stage, path) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'measure', ({{company_x}}::text || '/' || {{project_x}}::text || '/' || gen_random_uuid()::text || '.jpg'))

checks.name: 지우기 — 서버가 표시한다 (줄은 남는다)
checks.sql: update public.project_files set deleted_at = now(), deleted_by = {{x_owner_user}} where id = {{file_live}}

checks.name: 올린 메모는 바꾸지 못한다
checks.sql: update public.project_files set note = '바꿈' where id = {{file_live}}

checks.name: 어느 단계의 사진인지는 바꾸지 못한다
checks.sql: update public.project_files set stage = 'design' where id = {{file_live}}

checks.name: 지운 사진은 되살리지 못한다
checks.sql: update public.project_files set deleted_at = null, deleted_by = null where id = {{file_gone}}

checks.name: 지운 사람만 있고 때가 없으면 거절
checks.sql: update public.project_files set deleted_by = {{x_owner_user}} where id = {{file_live}}

checks.name: 줄 지우기는 서버도 못 한다 (표시로 남긴다)
구성원은 지우는 표시도 직접 못 한다
checks.sql: update public.project_files set deleted_at = now() where id = {{file_live}}

checks.name: 사진 버킷 — 비공개 · 5MB · JPEG · PNG
checks.sql: select public || '/' || file_size_limit || '/' || array_to_string(allowed_mime_types, ',') from storage.buckets where id = 'project-files'
